_about: B6 batch glossary (concepts/sandbox-and-execution, concepts/approval-and-interaction, concepts/acp-sdk-and-clients). Owner: B6 writer. Searched core.json, b2.json, b4.json, b5.json first; sandbox, capability-seam, approval-policy and acp already exist in core.json and are reused with {{term ...}}.

sandbox-escalation.short: A one-shot retry of a denied call at a strictly wider sandbox mode. It runs only after an approval answerer allows it.
sandbox-escalation.long: A request for the current mode needs no approval. A strictly wider target goes through ctx.approval before the call runs ({{cite packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/escalation.ts:172-206}}).

sdk-wire-protocol.short: The own newline-delimited JSON-RPC protocol of dsh, with one message per line. dsh-sdk-jsonrpc-server serves it over stdio. The TypeScript and Python SDKs speak it.
sdk-wire-protocol.long: The protocol package ({{cite packages/sdk/protocol/src/index.ts:1-9}}). The framing rules are in {{cite packages/sdk/protocol/README.md:34}}.
